description: This file defines the LiquidTemplateManager class, which manages rendering Liquid templates asynchronously, including caching, validation, and rendering to strings or HTML content within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: LiquidTemplateManager
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing, caching, and rendering Liquid templates asynchronously, supporting string and HTML content output, within the OrchardCore framework.

methods.name: RenderStringAsync
methods.description: Renders a Liquid template source string to a string asynchronously, with optional model and properties.

methods.name: RenderHtmlContentAsync
methods.description: Renders a Liquid template source string to an IHtmlContent asynchronously, with optional model and properties.

methods.name: RenderAsync
methods.description: Renders a Liquid template source string to a provided TextWriter asynchronously, with optional model and properties.

methods.name: GetCachedTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a cached LiquidViewTemplate for a given source string, parsing and caching it if necessary.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a Liquid template string, returning success status and parsing errors if any.
